method: Windows Graphics Capture of a dedicated browser HWND; native 1080p pixels; H.264 CFR 60fps; loading interval removed; bilingual chapter captions added; GIF time compressed to 0.6x.
framePacing: The capture maximum and recording timeline are 60Hz/60fps. The application rendered at a variable lower frame rate on this session, so CFR contains held frames. No AI motion interpolation was used. Encoded fps is not an application performance benchmark.
